verdict.rationale: stagewise documents a debugging loop. The agent can run your dev server and preview the app, take screenshots to inspect what users see, and use the tab's console and debugger. It can also run shell commands and scripts, and you can undo agent changes through diff review. Together these cover reproducing, diagnosing and checking fixes in web apps. missing for 10: an explicit documented reproduce→root-cause→verify workflow (fix verification is only implied by preview and shell access), hands-on or independent corroboration of debugging effectiveness, and evidence for non-web or backend debugging.

support.subject: As a developer, I can reproduce issues, narrow down root causes, and verify fixes

citations.quote: Run your dev server and see the result in stagewise
Debug visually — The agent takes screenshots and inspects what users see
Work with a coding agent that has full access to your tab's console and debugger
Shell access — Run shell commands, scripts, and package managers
The agent can read and edit files, run shell commands, interact with browser tabs via CDP, and orchestrate complex multi-step workflows.
